source:
@@U00593@@
Time will see to that, my friend. Trust yourself and you'll be just fine.

@@U00595@@
But how do we leave here? Where’s the coach, the horses, the coachman?

@@U00597@@
Just wait! We'll simply spread out this cloak— like so— and fly through the air. Remember, this is no petty venture, so go light on the luggage. A little hot air, that I'll provide, and off we go, flying high. Once we're buoyant, away we'll soar. Congratulations on your new career!

@@U00599@@
A rowdy student drinking party well underway.

@@U00601@@
Liven it up, men! Why so glum? Bend an elbow, for Chrisake! Set the place on fire, you soggy noodles!

@@U00603@@
Us! Hell! You! You haven't shown us shit! Where's that bag of tricks you're always touting, you old fart! Show us something gross!

@@U00605@@
(Pours a glass of wine over his head.)

@@U00606@@
There! How’s that? Two in one!
translation:
@@U00593@@
时间会证明这一点，我的朋友。相信自己，你会没事的。

@@U00595@@
但我们要如何离开这里呢？马车、马匹、车夫在哪里？

@@U00597@@
等等！我们只需展开这件斗篷——就像这样——然后在空中飞翔。请记住，这不是一件小事，所以请轻装上阵。我会提供一点热空气，然后我们就出发，飞得很高。一旦我们充满活力，我们就会展翅高飞。祝贺您的新职业生涯！

@@U00599@@
一场喧闹的学生酒会正在进行中。

@@U00601@@
伙计们，活跃起来吧！为什么这么闷闷不乐？弯曲肘部，看在上帝份上！放火烧了这个地方，你这湿漉漉的面条！

@@U00603@@
我们！地狱！你！你还没有给我们看什么狗屎！你老吹捧的那一套伎俩哪去了，你这个老家伙！给我们看一些恶心的东西！

@@U00605@@
（把一杯酒倒在他头上。）

@@U00606@@
在那里！怎么样？二合一！
